:::{#lem-prediction-error-split}
#### Prediction error splits at the conditional mean

Let $\truemeanf{\Predvar} \eqdef \E{\Outvar \mid \Predvar}$ be the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) of $\Outvar$ given $\Predvar$.
For any [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfnf{\Predvar}$,
the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) is the prediction error of $\truemean$
plus the [deviation](#def-deviation) of $\predfnf{\Predvar}$ from $\truemeanf{\Predvar}$:

$$\prederrf{\predfn} = \prederrf{\truemean} + \devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\prederrf{\predfn}
&= \predfnf{\Predvar} - \Outvar
&& \text{(definition of } \prederrf{\predfn} \text{)} \\
&= \paren{\truemeanf{\Predvar} - \Outvar} + \devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(add and subtract } \truemeanf{\Predvar} \text{)} \\
&= \prederrf{\truemean} + \devof{\predfnf{\Predvar}}{\truemeanf{\Predvar}}
&& \text{(definition of } \prederrf{\truemean} \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
